101-in-1 Sports Party Megamix.name: 101-in-1 Sports Party Megamix
101-in-1 Sports Party Megamix.summary: Players move the Wii Remote in games such as bowling, motorcross, and racing. Two to four players can compete against each other in a sack race, tennis, and skateboarding. Gamers who set high scores can unlock other games to play.

Chuck E. Cheese's Super Collection.name: Chuck E. Cheese's Super Collection
Chuck E. Cheese's Super Collection.summary: The Chuck E. Cheese's Super Collection offers over 25 fun-filled mini-games that the whole family can enjoy! Included are Chuck E. Cheese's Party Games & Sports Games collections. Challenge your friends and family in the ultimate party game showdown as you and your friends play with the King of Cool himself and his international group of friends! Make pizzas, race around the track in trucks, win cool prizes and so much more! It's the only place where a kid can be a kid! Join Chuck E. Cheese and his friends Helen, Pasqually, Jasper and Mr. Munch as you swing, shoot, steer and putt your way to victory! Play a variety of fun filled sports as you compete to become an all-star athlete. Do well to earn experience and medals to make it to the Professional League!

Dancing with the Stars - We Dance!.name: Dancing with the Stars: We Dance!
Dancing with the Stars - We Dance!.summary:
Seize your moment of glory in the battle of the ballroom with an all new all-star cast, new dances, and more music! The competition has never been as intense or more fun.

All New Stars from Past Seasons!

Including Apolo Anton Ohno, Joey Fatone, Drew Lachey, Jennie Garth, Mel “Scary Spice” B, Jane Seymour, Mark Cuban, and more!
New Professional Dancers!
Including two-time champion Julianne Hough, Derek Hough, and 6 others!
40 New Songs!
Including hits like Mony Mony, Push It, Lady Marmalade, She Bangs, Bootylicious, Black Horse and Cherry Tree, and more!
Engaging Dance Mechanics!
All new, special “flair moves”!
Improved gameplay including top-down scrolling dance moves, memory mini-games, and score multipliers.
All moves are tailored to the ease and playability of the Nintendo Wii and DS controls.
New and Improved Multiplayer Mode:
Including tournament play, co-op, and dance-off.

drei Fragezeichen, Die - Das verfluchte.name: Die drei???: Das verfluchte Schloss
drei Fragezeichen, Die - Das verfluchte.summary: A new case leads Jupiter, Peter and Bob to an abandoned castle where a ghost is up to mischief. But the three detectives soon discover that there is much more to this spooky story than initially assumed - The new Wii game will be released in spring 2009 to coincide with the start of the new feature film by the cult detectives, "The Three ??? - The Cursed Castle". can replay Wii. The exciting location Schloss offers numerous partially hidden rooms to explore and many tricky puzzles and exciting tasks to solve. Quick reactions, knowledge and logical thinking are required to solve the mystery.

Happy Neuron Academy.name: Happy Neuron Academy
Happy Neuron Academy.summary:
For the first time on Nintendo Wii, make a true assessment of your intellectual ability and start personalized brain training. Prepared in close collaboration with SBT (Scientific Brain Training), Happy Neuron Academy enables you to test and improve your cognitive skills. Memory, concentration, logic, language and visual-spatial ability are tested through a large number of exercises available in 10 levels of difficulty. Follow your progression at each stage,
let the game identify your strengths and weaknesses, and follow a truly
personalized scientific training. To highlight your games and keep working on improving your IQ, compare your results with friends in multi-player mode, up to 4 players.

Horse Life 2.name: Ellen Whitaker's Horse Life
Horse Life 2.summary:
In Horse Life 2 the player can select his horse from seven different breeds and can take care of it, train it and take part in various competitions.

The horse's behaviour is thereby depicted in a lifelike way in real-time. All competitions in the riding world such as dressage, show jumping and cross country are shown realistically. A gripping story really at-tracts the player to the screen and allows him to experience many differing tasks in a wide range of varied locations.

SSX Blur.name: SSX Blur
SSX Blur.summary: SSX Blur brings back the soul of SSX - remixed, re-energized, and fully realized. Revolutionary controls take full advantage of the Nintendo Wii's potential by putting you in total command of your skier or rider. The new On-the-Ground and In-the-Air controls will translate every motion you make into moves that create mountain legends. One hand controls you as you tear down the mountain; the other unleashes your array of aerial maneuvers. The mountain is your playground with SSX Blur. Familiar SSX faces return including Mac, Kaori, Psymon, and Allegra -- plus two all-new hot shot riders
